tcpRate.name: TCP new-connection rate limit
tcpRate.tip: Limit new TCP connections per source IP per second to reduce scans and connection floods.

udpFlood.name: UDP flood protection
udpFlood.tip: Limit UDP packets and new flows per source IP per second (uplink and downlink) to reduce amplification and floods.

nodeLimits.name: Max tunnels on node
nodeLimits.tip: Cap how many tunnels this node may host. 0 means unlimited.

blockHttpOnL4.name: Block L4 HTTP
blockHttpOnL4.tip: Intercept browser HTTP(S) on TCP/UDP tunnels and return a notice page.

perTunnelIp.name: Distinct source IPs per tunnel
perTunnelIp.tip: Limit how many different source IPs may use one tunnel at once.

cnResidency.name: CN nodes require CN clients
cnResidency.tip: Servers in region CN only accept clients whose geo region is also CN, reducing cross-border data transfer risk. Unknown client region is denied.

cnHttpFiling.name: Unlisted domains cannot create HTTP tunnels on CN nodes
cnHttpFiling.tip: HTTP tunnels only. TCP/UDP and raw IP access are not restricted. A domain that is not allowlisted still gets an ICP notice on shared ports 80/443 and on dedicated ports, even if DNS points at the node.

ipAcl.name: IP access control
ipAcl.tip: Filter by CIDR allow/deny lists. On Linux, syncs to nftables/iptables to DROP before TCP handshake and silently drop UDP; with an allow list, all other sources are denied.

onAttack.name: Auto-pause tunnel under attack
onAttack.tip: When UDP flood / TCP rate / per-tunnel IP rules fire and hit the threshold, pause that tunnel. 0 minutes means manual resume; N means auto-resume after N minutes.
